name: The United States Steel Hour
description: The United States Steel Hour is an anthology series which brought hour-long dramas to television from 1953 to 1963. The television series and the radio program that preceded it were both sponsored by the United States Steel Corporation.

videos.title: POW
videos.overview: The story of the psychological torment of American soldiers after they return home from Commmunist prison camps.

videos.title: Hope for a Harvest
videos.overview: A story examining the seeming loss of the American work ethic, as well as the issues of racism and prejudice.

videos.title: The Man in Possession
videos.overview: A penniless society girl falls in love with the handsome sheriff's man sent to keep an eye on her belongings.

videos.title: The Vanishing Point
videos.overview: In Paris, the Head of the Missing Persons Bureau disappears and his assistant, hoping for a promotion, searches for him.

videos.title: Hedda Gabler
videos.overview: In a small backward Norwegian town in the 1860s, a woman who is married to a scholar whom she does not love subtly asserts her power over the people in her life.

videos.title: The Rise of Carthage
videos.overview: A power-mad businessman finds true values in a desert utopia called Carthage.

videos.title: Papa Is All
videos.overview: A story about a Pennsylvania Dutch Mennonite family in the 1940s, in which the parents adhere to their faith while their two children desire to be more ""worldly"" until they feel the personal call to the Mennonite faith.

videos.title: Morning Star
videos.overview: A story revolving around a widow and her extended family on New York's Lower East Side, spanning the years 1910-1931, including such historic events as the Triangle Shirtwaist Factory fire, World War I, and the Great Depression, events that shaped the lives and destinies of the family.

videos.title: Welcome Home
videos.overview: The story of a beloved housekeeper and nanny who doesn't want to retire.

videos.title: The Last Notch
videos.overview: A story about a gunfighter who didn't particularly care for gunfighting.

videos.title: The Rise and Fall of Silas Lapham
videos.overview: Though rough around the edges, a self-made man tries to get his daughter admitted to Boston's high society 400.

videos.title: The End of Paul Dane
videos.overview: A story about a psychiatrist and two of his patients

videos.title: Fearful Decision
videos.overview: David Durfee's young son is kidnapped by desperate criminals,   yet he refuses to pay the ransom that the town feels would ensure the boy's safety.

videos.title: Baseball Blues
videos.overview: The story of a 40-year-old pitcher facing his retirement from baseball.

videos.title: The Man in the Goldfish Bowl
The Thief
videos.overview: A man (played by James Dean) is falsely accused of stealing in this very good melodrama.  Dean harbors a secret love for a married woman, but he does not get the girl in the end.

videos.title: Freighter
videos.overview: A captain with 25 years of service on the ""Singapore"" faces a mental collapse as he takes his freighter out on its last voyage. Tension among the crew members mounts as the men battle one another and the elements on the fateful trip to Hong Kong.

videos.title: No Time for Sergeants
videos.overview: A country bumpkin is drafted into the Air Force and wreaks havoc.

videos.title: The Rack
videos.overview: A young Army officer faces a court-martial as a result of his collaboration with the enemy while a prisoner of war.

videos.title: The Roads to Home
videos.overview: A bankrupt man, who becomes a migrant oil worker to repay his debts,   journeys with his family and dreams of returning to the home they once owned.

videos.title: Fearful Decision
videos.overview: David Durfee's young son is kidnapped by desperate criminals, yet he refuses to pay the ransom that the town feels would ensure the boy's safety.

videos.title: Big Winner
videos.overview: The life of an Italian-American family is continuously upset by their Uncle Zi-Zi's schemes to appear as a contestant on a TV quiz program, on which he is certain that his fortune will be made.

videos.title: The Meanest Man in the World
A Wind from the South
videos.overview: A story about an Irish country girl's first love

videos.title: Noon on Doomsday
videos.overview: When the narrow-minded citizens of a community acquit a psychopathic bully for the murder of an immigrant shopkeeper, a retired judge tries to persuade the community to rectify this miscarriage of justice.

videos.title: Honest in the Rain
videos.overview: A story about compulsive gambling

videos.title: The Old Lady Shows Her Medals
Operation Three R's
videos.overview: During World War II, Corporal Neville, an intelligent young man awaiting appointment to officers' candidate school, is asked, much to his displeasure, to become an instructor to illiterates.

videos.title: Bang the Drum Slowly
videos.overview: The powerful moving story of the friendship between the star pitcher of a baseball team and a catcher who is dying from Hodgkin's Disease.

videos.title: The Old Lady Shows Her Medals
Shadow of Evil
videos.overview: The town's sheriff, possessed of an irrational hatred of outlaws, kills a young man, claiming that the youngster had made an attempt on his life.

videos.title: The Bottle Imp
videos.overview: Phillip the Sailor meets Andre, Haiti's wealthiest inhabitant, who wants to sell Phillip a magic bottle containing an all-powerful Imp, which brought him his great fortune. Phillip isn't interested in   the power the bottle can bring until he meets a beautiful girl whom he wants to marry, but he doesn't have the wealth which the girl's father demands.

videos.title: A Drum is a Woman
videos.overview: The love story of Zajj and Caribee Jones, told in the form of a jazz ""ballet""

videos.title: Up Above the World So High
Huck Finn
videos.overview: A musical version of the classic story

videos.title: Little Charlie Don't Want a Saddle
videos.overview: A mute spinster who becomes a mail-order bride to a widower goes to his farm and wins over the widower and his younger son, but not his older son, who feels that his father is not being true to the memory of the boy's mother.

videos.title: Hour of the Rat
videos.overview: John Woodruffe is tormented by memories of the horrors he suffered in a Japanese prison camp during World War II. He recalls his vow to avenge the death of a chaplain executed by Sakamura, the brutal camp adjutant. Years later, Woodruffe finds himself face to face with the object of his bitter hate, Sakamura.

videos.title: Old Marshals Never Die
videos.overview: Bat Bethune, former marshal of a New Mexico town, has become a legendary figure as a result of his boldness during the wild early days of the town's history. But, in his old age, he is given to shooting at imaginary badmen, endangering the inhabitants. Finally, the mayor decides Bethune must leave town.

videos.title: Second Chance
videos.overview: Dr. Victor Payson, a widower for just 6 months and father of a teenage daughter, is slated for the post of Chief of Surgeons of Collins General Hospital. But the wife of the hospital's director plants doubt among Payson's colleagues as to his suitability for the job because of his romance with a young divorcee.

videos.title: Night of Betrayal
videos.overview: The son of a wealthy French collaborator, who is secretly a member of the underground, falls in love and marries a young girl hiding from the Gestapo.

videos.title: Trouble-in-Law
videos.overview: For years May Golden has ended every argument with her husband by threatening to get a job. When Mimi, her youngest married daughter,   becomes exasperated with her mother's daily visits and free advice,   May decides it's time to prove her value by making good her threat.

videos.title: The Pink Burro
videos.overview: Former vaudeville singer Lil Andrews ambitiously makes preparations for her daughter's professional singing debut.  She is unaware that the girl, who is living out of town with an aunt while taking singing lessons, has secretly married and given up plans for a singing career.

videos.title: Big Doc's Girl
videos.overview: A young woman whose mother is in a sanitorium and father has just died of malaria must find a way to cope with life.

videos.title: The Girl Who Knew Too Much
The Case of the Missing Wife
The Mating Machine
videos.overview: In “The Mating Machine,” we meet four people involved with such a gadget — Geraldine Brooks, who runs it; Diana Lynn, as a waitress who mistakes Miss Brooks’ office for an employment agency: John Ericson, as a physicist who thinks he needs a wile, selected scientifically, and George Grizzard, as a disbeliever, They are all thrown together a bit too concidentally, but after that, it is every man (and woman) for himself (or herself).

videos.title: The Two Worlds of Charlie Gordon
videos.overview: Charlie Gordon, a retarded man working in a bakery, is made a genius through medical technology.

videos.title: Private Eye, Private Eye
videos.overview: Producer Max Liebman turns the tables and investigates the private eye.   Sketches:   Private Life of a Private Eye:  Mike Mallet's after a thug, but his doting wife keeps getting in his way.   Nairobi Safe Robbery:  Simians sack a safe.   The Good Old Days:  A widow beseeches Percy Dovetonsils to find her husband's murderer.   More Gore:  The sponsor has doubts about his TV Series.   Peter Legato:  The star of the series is the music.   Silent Movie:  Nick Carter triumphs again.   Musical Highlights:   Conductor Charles Sanford   ""Chase"" Ballet (""Son of Drum Suite:) ..... videos.title: Welcome Home
videos.overview: The story of a beloved housekeeper and nanny who doesn't want to retire.

videos.title: The Shame of Paula Marsten
videos.overview: Paula Marsten, who has attempted suicide and been brought to a mental hospital in a state of nervous collapse, is recognized by the head physician, Dr. King, who refuses to become involved in the case.

videos.title: Trial Without Jury
videos.overview: Mr. and Mrs. Pollard feel that their son-in-law, novelist Mark Davis, isn't a fit parent for their grandchild. Lawyer Ellen Reed is convinced the Pollards' charge is based on their disapproval of Mark's latest book.

videos.title: The Haven
videos.overview: Although it disappoints his wife and kids, a man can't bear to spend another summer in their cottage by the lake so he decides to sell the house and use the money for a long trip.

videos.title: Double-Edged Sword
videos.overview: Colonel and Lady Morrigan were very nicely provided for in their brother's will. Now Muriel no longer need fear a poverty-stricken   old age and the Colonel can pay his debts and renew membership in his beloved club. But then the Colonel studies the will and discovers that, in order to get the money, he'll have to tell a lie so he refuses it.

videos.title: Street of Love
videos.overview: Romance blossoms between a lovely Soviet guide and an American Senator's son, despite objections from their families.

videos.title: Little Lost Sheep
videos.overview: Phyllis and Arthur Bannister, teachers at Thoreau College, receive a real shock at the faculty meeting. It's been decided that the school 'image' has got to be modernized and a Madison Avenue expert is hired to do the job.

videos.title: Tangle of Truth
videos.overview: Sue Dulaney and Gordon Killman go out for a drink, and on the way home, Gordon runs another car off the road. He calls the police but refuses to give his name.

videos.title: The Bitter Sex
videos.overview: A woman decides to put an end to the marital bliss of her ex-husband and his new wife.

videos.title: The Other Woman
videos.overview: A woman hears a mysterious message in another woman's voice on a Bach tape she's listening to.

videos.title: The Inner Panic
videos.overview: A young man with a speech impediment who is having a hard time landing his first job gets a job in the mailroom of a big company through his mother's intervention and quickly gains confidence, loses his stutter, and finds love with a young woman who works at the same company.

videos.title: The Troubled Heart
videos.overview: Margot Forrester, a young mother of two small children and an active participant in her community's social life, has been told that she has a serious heart defect, which even surgery may not correct.

videos.title: Night Run to the West
videos.overview: Caring for her elderly invalid husband is a lonely task for Francie Broderick, and when a truck driver named Charlie Williams barges into her life, she sees him as her salvation.

videos.title: Moment of Rage
videos.overview: Paul Gardiner, Latin teacher at a private school, was an adopted child who never bothered to inquire who his real parents were. But now his snobbish future mother-in-law insists that he learn their identities before he gets married.

videos.title: The Soldier Ran Away
videos.overview: Twelve-year-old Jeff Wheeler, whose father is an Army doctor stationed in Germany, wants to prove to the old man that he is self-reliant so he sneaks into the attic at night to make a pipe rack for him.

videos.title: The Many Ways of Heaven
videos.overview: Russell Hampshire hasn't spent much time with his son Teddy during summer vacation, but the youngster has found a substitute--Captain Walker, a retired airline pilot.

videos.title: The Old Lady Shows Her Medals
